rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something that causes fear.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a stronger horror-like or ominous impression.

example.english: Walking along this mountain road alone at night is scary.
example.traditional: 夜晚一個人行呢條山路，好恐怖。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 ni1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 hou2 hung2 bou3

rows.note: Use this when “scary” means astonishing or uncannily striking rather than frightening.

example.traditional: 呢部電腦嘅速度快得驚人。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 cuk1 dou6 faai3 dak1 ging1 jan4
